description: Cartographie du réseau d'assainissement du SILA is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte du Lac d'Annecy. Location of the sewerage network (public and private) in the territory of the Syndicat Mixte du Lac d’Annecy (SILA) in Haute-Savoie (74). Coverage: Syndicat Mixte du Lac d'Annecy. The portal shows the English title as "Mapping of the SILA sewerage network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Mixte du Lac d'Annecy. Its keywords include step, regards, reseau, collecteurs, eaux-usees, assainissement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-03-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
